items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: Yeah, I remember him saying he was playing with Cook. I remember that.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. And... Do you remember whom he was playing with? Would that have been Doc Cook or Doc Cook? That's right. Because I remember him saying so. Well, you see, that also connects with Jimmy Noon, who was playing over there, too, with Doc Cook.
Yeah, I remember him saying he was playing with Cook. I remember that.
And... I wonder if that leads us into anybody on that clarinet. Do you remember ever making a record with Clifford King? Clarinet King.
